name: SelectionToolbar
description: The floating toolbar for selected items (messages, tasks): the count, an optional hint, the actions on the selection, More while some are out of the row, then ×. One row at any width: what doesn't fit gives way, measured in the width it floats in, and never wraps. A `role="toolbar"`, one Tab stop with the arrow keys inside: give it an `aria-label`.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: If `true`, using keyboard navigation will wrap focus to the other end of the toolbar once the end is reached.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: SelectionToolbarAction
description: One action on the selection: a 14px icon and a label, an `md` ghost button with a mouse on a desktop, a 44px bar button showing its icon alone on a phone and a touch screen.

props.name: children
props.description: The label. While only the icon shows, the label is its accessible name and its tooltip.

props.name: icon
props.description: The action's 14px icon.

props.name: loading
props.description: Busy: shows the spinner and blocks activation (click, Enter, Space and form submission) while keeping the button focusable. A busy button is `aria-disabled`, not natively `disabled`, so the focus a press left on it stays there and is still there when the wait ends.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: The spinner's accessible name while `loading`: say what is happening.

props.name: menu
props.description: The action opens a menu: a 12px chevron follows the label. Open the menu upward.

props.name: moreItem
props.description: What the action is in More's menu while it is there. By default a `DropdownMenuItem` with its icon and label that calls its `onClick`. Required: its menu in More's (a `DropdownMenuSubmenu` with the same choices). Its `onClick` only opens its own menu, so it has no default, and without one it would vanish into More.

props.name: secondary
props.description: Moves into More before the labels give way, the last first.

props.name: focusableWhenDisabled
props.description: Whether the button should be focusable when disabled.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: SelectionToolbarActions
description: The actions on the selection, in one row.

props.name: overflow
props.description: `scroll`: the group takes the rest of its line and scrolls sideways instead of giving way, its items whole, the side that hides more fading. Mark an applied or chosen item `data-active`: it is kept in view.

props.name: wrapLine
props.description: Groups with the same `wrapLine` wrap onto the same line, in their order, a fixed gap apart; a group without one takes a line of its own.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When `true` all toolbar items in the group are disabled.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: SelectionToolbarClose
description: ×, last: ends the selection, as Escape does.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Its accessible name, such as "Cancel".

name: SelectionToolbarCount
description: What the actions act on ("3 selected"), first. Announced when it changes. Put the number in `SelectionToolbarCountValue`.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: SelectionToolbarCountValue
description: The number in the count, in Space Mono.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: SelectionToolbarDock
description: Where the toolbar floats: centered, 12px above the bottom of the list or conversation it sits in (plus the safe area), 20px from its sides. Its parent must be positioned.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: SelectionToolbarHint
description: A short line after the count, such as "1 will be skipped". The first to give way: it is then read by screen readers only.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: SelectionToolbarItem
description: Any other control of the toolbar, such as a thread's select-all checkbox before the count, so the arrow keys reach it. It takes the toolbar's focus handling only: the control keeps its role and its own keys.

props.name: children
props.description: The control, such as `<Checkbox />`. It keeps its own role and keys.

name: SelectionToolbarMore
description: More, after the actions, shown only while some are in it. Render it as a `DropdownMenuTrigger` whose menu opens upward (`side="top"`), with `SelectionToolbarMoreItems` in the menu.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Its accessible name, such as "More actions".
